President Murmu Addresses Nation on Independence Day Eve, CM Yadav Speaks on UCC and Youth in Politics

On the eve of India's 80th Independence Day, President Droupadi Murmu delivered an address to the nation. She stated that the government is undertaking comprehensive reforms to prevent exam paper leaks and safeguard the future of young people. President Murmu also highlighted 'Operation Sindoor' and a Naxal-free India in her speech. Meanwhile, Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav stated that the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) will soon be implemented in the state to strengthen equality. He also urged youth to play an active role in politics.
